newsitem.title: USA: GM says 10,187 U.S., Mexico workers idle.
newsitem.headline: GM says 10,187 U.S., Mexico workers idle.

text.p: General Motors Corp said that as of 1100 EDT/1500 GMT on Wednesday, 10,187 GM workers in the United States and Mexico had been idled as a result of the strike against the company by the Canadian Auto Workers union.
"We will not speculate on when or which additional facilities could be affected by the work stoppage," GM said.

The Canadian strike has affected 1,350 workers at the Detroit/Hamtramck GM vehicle assembly plant; 1,050 workers at the Tonawanda, Mich., engine plant; 1,790 workers at the Ypsilanti, Mich., transmission plant; 61 workers at the Flint, Mich., components plant; and 5,936 workers at various Delphi Division plants in the U.S. and Mexico.
GM's 26,000 Canadian Auto Workers members launched a strike on October 3 that shut down all of GM's Canadian production on October 9.
